VideoProject.title: VideoProject
VideoProject.description: Cloud-synchronized video editing project with multi-track timeline clips, text overlays, and audio tracks.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the project creator.

ownerName.description: Display name of the project creator.

description.description: Short summary or notes for the video project.

shareVisibility.description: Sharing mode for the video project.

shareCode.description: Share code used to open shared videos when shareVisibility is link_anyone.

clips.description: Ordered list of visual timeline clip objects (up to 40).

overlays.description: List of timed text overlay objects (up to 30).

audioTracks.description: List of timed audio/voiceover track objects (up to 10).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the project was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the project was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

SavedShare.title: SavedShare
SavedShare.description: Bookmark reference to a shared video project opened by the user.

shareCode.description: Share code used to open the project.

savedAt.description: Server timestamp when the shared video was saved (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/projects/{projectId}.description: User-owned and link-shared video editing projects.

/users/{userId}/saved_shares/{shareId}.description: Per-user bookmarks of shared video projects.
